meals.title: What did you eat today?
meals.description: What you eat becomes the next poop monster.

battle.title: Battle
battle.description: Normal attacks are automatic. Brace yourself and fire only while charging your special move.

logs.title: Battle log
logs.description: Look back on the results of your battles and how you felt that day.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Collect the poop monsters that have become your friends.

account.title: Account
account.description: Link a Google account to continue with the same records on another device.

Home.description: Log what you eat, then take on poop monsters in battle.
Home.supportingCopy: As you play, meal and bowel logs are saved.

Pwa.installDescription: Add it to your Home Screen to open it like an app.
Pwa.iosStepOne: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen
Pwa.iosStepThree: Tap Add in the top-right corner
Pwa.chromiumInstructions: Use the browser menu or the install icon in the address bar to add the app.
Pwa.manifestDescription: Keep meal and bowel logs through battles.

AccountMenu.signOutWarning: Logging out creates a new anonymous account. To return to your current records, log in with the same Google account.

Report.title: Weekly poop report
Report.entryDescription: Review this week's trends from your records
Report.recordedDays: You have entries for {count} days. Review summaries, comparisons, and meal trends with Premium.
Report.lockedTitle: See this week's trends in more detail
Report.lockedDescription: See how hardness changes and how meals relate to your records with Premium. What you see here is a sample, not your own data.
Report.hardnessDescription: 1 is firmer and 7 is looser. This is not a diagnosis; it shows your records.
Report.stableBandNote: The darker bars are the 3–5 band, the same range as "Share between 3 and 5" above.
Report.mostFrequentWeekday: Most frequent day: {weekday}. Morning {morning}, afternoon {afternoon}, evening {night}.
Report.noMealRelationship: Log both meals and bowel movements to review recorded relationships within 24 hours here.
Report.relatedBowel: Related to {count} bowel records. Average hardness is {average}.
Report.mealDisclaimer: This does not show that a meal caused anything. It makes bowel movements within 24 hours of your logged meals easier to review.
Report.noMealFoodGroupAnalysis: Comparisons appear here after logging at least 5 of the same food group and 3 bowel movements within 24 hours.
Report.errorDescription: Check your sign-in status and try again.
Report.linkRequiredDescription: Without linking, you cannot restore your purchase when you change devices.
Report.purchaseSuccess: Thank you for your purchase. It may take a moment to appear.
